183: 		}

187: 		))); err != nil {

189: 		}

192: 	default:

194: 			"image already found, skipping pull phase: %s",
195: 			ref.String(),
196: 		))); err != nil {

198: 		}

200: 	}

208: 		}

211: 	auth, err := d.getDockerAuths(ctx, ref, req.Registry, p)
212: 	if err != nil {
213: 		return fmt.Errorf("could not get docker authentication: %w", err)
214: 	}

430: // registryToString converts the Registry struct to a base64 encoding for json strings.
431: func registryToString(reg types.AuthConfig) (string, error) {
432: 	// Docker stores the username and password in an auth section types.AuthConfig
433: 	// formatted as user:pass then base64ed. This is not documented clearly.
434: 	// https://github.com/docker/cli/blob/master/cli/config/configfile/file.go#L76
435: 	if reg.Auth != "" {
436: 		bytes, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(reg.Auth)
437: 		if err != nil {
438: 			return "", err
439: 		}
440: 		userAndPass := strings.SplitN(string(bytes), ":", 2)
441: 		if len(userAndPass) != 2 {
442: 			return "", errors.Errorf("auth field of docker authConfig must be base64ed user:pass")
443: 		}
444: 		reg.Username, reg.Password = userAndPass[0], userAndPass[1]
445: 		reg.Auth = ""
446: 	}
447: 	bs, err := json.Marshal(reg)
448: 	if err != nil {
449: 		return "", err
450: 	}

452: 	return base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(bs), nil

476: 	if err := p.Publish(ctx, NewLogEvent(model.LogLevelInfo, finalLogMsg)); err != nil {
